remarks: Recently painted inside and out, this four-bedroom home with a den offers more space than you might expect. The room sizes and layout are worth seeing in person to appreciate how spacious the home feels. The good-sized kitchen flows into the dining and living areas, with room to gather and enjoy everyday living. Recessed lighting throughout adds to the refreshed feel. The den provides extra space for an office or a separate sitting room. The large primary bedroom has its own bathroom, and the hallway bathroom features a newly remodeled shower. Nearby William Peak Park and its renovated public pool add to the neighborhood’s appeal, along with Buena Park’s community events and rec
